about: Required-files manifest for a repo prepared as if it will go public (quest 977d3efb). Read by skills/conduct/scripts/lib/bootstrap.mjs. Each item passes when one of `anyOf` exists (default: `path`) and, when given, every `contains` marker appears in it. `glob` items read every matching file and need each marker in at least one of them. A stack's items apply when its `when` file exists; its `templates` map replaces a core item's template for that stack. Templates live in ./files and are written only where the target is missing.

items.why: What the repo is, how to run it, how to test it.
A public repo without a license is all-rights-reserved.
Where to report a vulnerability, before it is reported in an issue.
Canonical agent guidance; one file every harness reads.
Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md; the @AGENTS.md import keeps one canonical file. The import expands only at the directory a session starts in.
Line endings and indentation agree across editors and agents.
Build output, dependencies and local env files stay out of history.
A PR gate that cancels superseded runs, cannot hang, and scans for secrets.
Action pins and dependencies get update PRs.
Every PR states its door; /conduct's merge gate reads it.
CI and every lane run the same Node major.
npm warns on a mismatched Node before anything runs. No template: add the field by hand.
One formatter, so diffs carry changes and not whitespace.
npm dependencies get update PRs too.

settings.why: Merged branches do not pile up on origin.
